# Smallest AI

Smallest AI builds full-stack, low-latency enterprise voice AI. Its in-house models such as Lightning (text-to-speech), Pulse (speech-to-text), Electron (small language model), and Hydra (speech-to-speech) that power the Waves API suite and the Atoms voice-agent platform for support, sales, collections, and scheduling.

Smallest AI was founded in by Sudarshan Kamath and Akshat Mandloi and is headquartered in San Francisco with engineering in Bengaluru. The platform is built for enterprise scale with SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, GDPR, and ISO 27001 compliance.

## Products

* [Text to Speech (Lightning)](https://smallest.ai/text-to-speech): Ultra-low-latency TTS for real-time voice agents.  
* [Speech to Text (Pulse)](https://smallest.ai/speech-to-text): High-accuracy transcription across 38 languages.  
* [Speech to Speech (Hydra)](https://smallest.ai/speech-to-speech): Native full-duplex speech-to-speech model.  
* [Voice Cloning](https://smallest.ai/voice-cloning): Production-ready voice clones from a short sample.  
* [Voice Agents (Atoms)](https://smallest.ai/voice-agents): Build, deploy, and analyze real-time voice agents.  
* [On-Premise](https://smallest.ai/on-premise): Private/on-prem deployment for regulated industries.
